top.line: VoiceDebrief's techniques for any voice app, in a public Apache 2.0 repository, with a prompt for your Claude.
top.para: Record, transcribe, debrief, control, layers, CI.

in-short.line: A worked example; record without loss; offline transcription; Apple Intelligence; voice control; three layers; CI; a prompt.

why.line: People working on voice projects should not have to rediscover what we figured out.
why.para: Public, Apache 2.0, documented beside the code.

record.line: Written to disk from the first second as repairable WAV, with a safety-net copy and the microphone guarded.

transcribe.line: SpeechAnalyzer on the device: a live preview, then the kept transcript from the file; 6 min 44 s in 5.4 s.
transcribe.para: And the audio tap crash to avoid.

debrief.line: Foundation Models: a fresh session per request, long notes in parts, one small question at a time.
debrief.para: Also labels while you speak and clean text.

control.line: Fixed phrases first, then one tool call that does nothing by itself, then a person confirms.

layers.line: Code, the model on the device, agents: push each step to the lowest layer that can do it.

ci.line: Agents without a Mac: CI is the compiler, every screen photographed, every green push to TestFlight.
ci.para: A reality file and a develop guide.

prompt.line: A prompt to give your Claude, pointing at the files for each technique.

limits.line: Tested in parts, single-run timings, recent hardware needed, voice control still an experiment.

sources.line: The VoiceDebrief repository and site, and earlier articles.
